sprint_goal: Deliver MVP ML feature store integrating Feast, Databricks, and Redis with feature registry, batch & real-time serving, lineage tracking, monitoring, and secure access control.

tasks.title: Design feature registry schema and metadata model
tasks.description: Define schema for feature registration, versioning, and metadata tracking using Feast registry. Include lineage metadata, owner info, and version control structure.

tasks.title: Implement feature registration API in Python SDK
tasks.description: Create Python interfaces for feature registration, updates, and metadata retrieval with Feast integration. Ensure validation and error handling.

tasks.title: Develop batch feature computation workflow on Databricks
tasks.description: Implement Spark job templates for hourly/daily batch feature computation and storage in Delta tables. Include version tracking and timestamp correctness.

tasks.title: Set up real-time feature serving using Redis
tasks.description: Deploy Redis cluster and integrate Feast online store for <10ms latency feature access. Optimize key structure and caching strategy for fast lookups.

tasks.title: Implement point-in-time join logic for training data
tasks.description: Add logic to perform point-in-time correct joins using Feast APIs to align historical features with training event timestamps, minimizing training-serving skew.

tasks.title: Develop feature monitoring and drift detection module
tasks.description: Implement monitoring system to track production feature distributions and detect drift using statistical metrics. Configure alerting for threshold breaches.

tasks.title: Integrate Unity Catalog-based access control
tasks.description: Integrate Unity Catalog permissions system to provide team-level access control over features. Implement role-based read/write policies.

tasks.title: Expose REST API layer for feature management and access
tasks.description: Build REST endpoints for feature registration, retrieval, and metadata operations. Integrate with backend services and ensure consistent behavior with SDK.

tasks.title: Create automated unit and integration tests for registry and serving
tasks.description: Develop test cases for registry CRUD operations, batch jobs, Redis serving, and access control APIs. Include performance and latency tests.

tasks.title: Prepare documentation and developer onboarding guide
tasks.description: Document SDK usage, API references, data flow diagrams, and operational best practices. Create onboarding guide for data scientists.

risks.description: Redis latency may exceed 10ms under heavy concurrent load.
risks.mitigation: Conduct load testing early; tune Redis configuration; consider clustering or connection pooling to ensure p99 latency compliance.

risks.description: Batch feature computation may not maintain point-in-time correctness.
risks.mitigation: Implement strict timestamp handling and validation in Spark jobs; add automated consistency tests.

risks.description: Access control integration with Unity Catalog may delay development.
risks.mitigation: Start with stub permissions model; validate early with Databricks API; ensure fallback logic if Unity Catalog unavailable.

risks.description: Feature monitoring and drift detection may produce false positives due to limited data.
risks.mitigation: Calibrate alert thresholds based on historical data; implement manual review pipeline for initial alerts.

definition_of_done: All SDK and REST endpoints pass functional and integration tests.
Batch and online feature serving achieve <10ms p99 latency under 500 concurrent requests.
Feature registry supports versioning and lineage metadata.
Access control integrated with Unity Catalog and verified with test users.
Monitoring and drift detection alerts configurable and verified.
Documentation completed and reviewed by ML team.
All tasks reviewed, merged, and deployed to staging environment.
